scope: Q05-a failed overall: initial Cursor and Claude QA builds each had one ephemeral agent_relay_credential in a metadata-only response, but the original Cursor workspace did not rebuild after the reported follow-up. The only new Cursor claim used the tester's excluded second session identifier, so it was not counted. Claude rebuilt the same original workspace (build 3) with a fresh ephemeral secret and the tester confirmed a normal reply. Stop builds of both original workspaces had zero secret metadata; only the original stopped Cursor workspace was later explicitly authorized for deletion. The excluded Cursor and rebuilt Claude workspaces cleaned up naturally, and the original Cursor delete completed. No QA template workspaces remain; both QA pools are healthy at baseline. No secret values or build-parameter responses were retrieved.
